entries.note: Install/download uses an isolated npm prefix and verifies the newly managed executable. Existing global native installations use their own supported update command. A custom executable has no inferred installer, updater or configuration format. Every launch argument remains an argv element; never replace this with eval.

Launch never silently installs or updates. The menu exposes those explicit actions. With an rEngine context, launch execs the Node provider adapter to supply project-bound MCP configuration; without a context it execs the selected CLI directly. Custom executable formats are not inferred: they receive a generic MCP configuration path and keep responsibility for consuming it. check-resume uses the same managed/PATH executable lookup and probes Codex resume help and login status without installing, updating or launching a coding session.
